fusions.name: Broadside
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 16 damage, up to 2.2 times that at maximum range, and knocks the target back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Swell and Break
fusions.desc: Hits every enemy within 4 tiles, dealing 28 damage to each and ignoring their armour. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Fair Wind
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 12% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Sea Legs
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your next strike gains 15% critical hit chance. Once every 6 seconds.
